papers.title: Measles-Specific IgG Antibody Levels and Associated Demographic and Vaccination Factors Among Children in Diyala Governorate, Iraq: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Measles is a significant cause of death in children, despite the availability of safe and cost-effective measles vaccines. Monitoring measles-specific IgG antibody levels is essential for evaluating vaccine-induced immunity and identifying factors associated with protective immune responses. This study was aimed to assess of measles IgG antibody levels and identify associated factors affecting measles immunity among children in Diyala Governorate / Iraq. A cross-sectional study was conducted between October 1, 2025, and April 30, 2026. Ninety children aged 1–14 years who had received at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine were enrolled from primary health care centres in Diyala Governorate. Venous blood samples were collected, and serum anti-measles IgG antibody concentrations were determined using the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Demographic characteristics and vaccination history were obtained through a structured questionnaire. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29, with statistical significance set at P < 0.05 Among the 90 enrolled children, 53.3% were males and 46.7% were females. Female children showed significantly higher measles IgG antibody concentrations than males (64.74 ± 58.91 vs. 46.60 ± 46.55 ng/L; P = 0.006). No significant differences in measles IgG antibody concentrations were observed according to vaccination status (65.77 ± 73.29 vs. 50.48 ± 41.64 ng/L; P = 0.682) or age groups (P = 0.341). Furthermore, a weak positive correlation was found between measles IgG antibody concentration and the number of vaccine doses; however, this correlation was not statistically significant (r = 0.070, P = 0.512).

papers.title_zh: 麻疹特异性IgG抗体水平及其相关的流行病学和疫苗接种因素在伊拉克迪亚拉省儿童中的研究:一项横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Measles is a significant cause of death in children, despite the availability of safe and cost-effective measles vaccines. Monitoring measles-specific IgG antibody levels is essential for evaluating vaccine-induced immunity and identifying factors associated with protective immune responses. This study was aimed to assess of measles IgG antibody levels and identify associated factors affecting measles immunity among children in Diyala Governorate / Iraq. A cross-sectional study was conducted between October 1, 2025, and April 30, 2026. Ninety children aged 1–14 years who had received at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine were enrolled from primary health care centres in Diyala Governorate. Venous blood samples were collected, and serum anti-measles IgG antibody concentrations were determined using the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Demographic characteristics and vaccination history were obtained through a structured questionnaire. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29, with statistical significance set at P < 0.05 Among the 90 enrolled children, 53.3% were males and 46.7% were females. Female children showed significantly higher measles IgG antibody concentrations than males (64.74 ± 58.91 vs. 46.60 ± 46.55 ng/L; P = 0.006). No significant differences in measles IgG antibody concentrations were observed according to vaccination status (65.77 ± 73.29 vs. 50.48 ± 41.64 ng/L; P = 0.682) or age groups (P = 0.341). Furthermore, a weak positive correlation was found between measles IgG antibody concentration and the number of vaccine doses; however, this correlation was not statistically significant (r = 0.070, P = 0.512).
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹是儿童死亡的重要原因,尽管已有安全且成本效益高的麻疹 疫苗。监测麻疹特异性IgG抗体水平对于评估疫苗诱导的免疫力以及识别与保护性免疫应答相关的因素至关重要。本研究旨在评估麻疹 IgG抗体水平,并识别影响麻疹免疫力的相关因素。研究于2025年10月1日至2026年4月30日间进行。从迪亚拉省初级卫生保健中心招募了90名年龄在1至14岁之间、至少接种过一剂含麻疹的疫苗的儿童。采集静脉血样,并使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)法测定血清抗麻疹 IgG抗体浓度。通过结构化问卷获取人口学特征和疫苗接种史。统计分析使用SPSS 29版进行,统计学显著性设定为P < 0.05。在90名纳入研究的儿童中,53.3%为男性,46.7%为女性。女性儿童的麻疹 IgG抗体浓度显著高于男性(64.74 ± 58.91 vs. 46.60 ± 46.55 ng/L;P = 0.006)。根据疫苗接种状态(65.77 ± 73.29 vs. 50.48 ± 41.64 ng/L;P = 0.682)或年龄组(P = 0.341)未观察到麻疹 IgG抗体浓度的显著差异。此外,发现麻疹 IgG抗体浓度与疫苗接种剂量之间存在弱正相关,但该相关性并不具有统计学意义(r = 0.070,P = 0.512)。

papers.title: Development of a New Lyophilized Live-Attenuated Measles–Rubella (MR) Vaccine Formulation Designed for Lower-Cost Production in Africa
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: This work describes the development of a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation consists of a stabilizer solution (containing only non-animal-derived excipients) and high-titer MR viral bulks (produced in MRC-5 cells by a modernized process) prepared at a ratio of 95% and 5% (v/v), respectively. Methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses were employed. Based on the down-selected hits, candidate lyophilized MR formulations were designed, prepared, and evaluated by comparative storage stability assessments. Results: First, protein-based bulking agents (used in many commercial lyophilized MR-containing vaccines) were avoided in favor of sucrose/mannitol mixtures. Second, ~50 excipients were screened, and two additional key stabilizing components were identified (both previously reported to stabilize MR viruses): sodium phosphate buffer and urea. Next, stability assessments were performed on different variations of a candidate lyophilized MR formulation to elucidate the inter-relationships between sucrose–mannitol ratios, cake integrity, and MR virus stability. An optimized MR vaccine formulation composition (post-reconstitution) of 5% (w/v) mannitol, 5% (w/v) sucrose, 50 mM urea, 25 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.5), and 5% (v/v) viral bulks was established. When this formulation was lyophilized at lab-scale in a single-dose format, both MR viruses displayed promising stability profiles during storage under real-time and accelerated conditions. A five-dose format was then evaluated in a pilot-scale freeze-dryer by using a 2X formulation filled into larger vials, lyophilized, and then reconstituted to 1X concentration. Conclusions: Results demonstrated the feasibility of a new, lower-cost, lyophilized, multidose MR formulation for potential use with a live-attenuated MR vaccine candidate targeted for local production in Africa.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This work aimed to develop a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa, addressing the need for affordable and stable vaccines in resource-limited settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles for a lyophilized MR vaccine formulation, with the population consisting of viral bulks produced in MRC-5 cells and evaluated for stability under various conditions.
analysis.methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions were employed to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses.
analysis.main_results: First, protein-based bulking agents were avoided in favor of sucrose/mannitol mixtures. Second, ~50 excipients were screened, and two additional key stabilizing components were identified: sodium phosphate buffer and urea. Stability assessments were performed on different variations of a candidate lyophilized MR formulation to elucidate the inter-relationships between sucrose–mannitol ratios, cake integrity, and MR virus stability.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrated the feasibility of a new, lower-cost, lyophilized, multidose MR formulation for potential use with a live-attenuated MR vaccine candidate targeted for local production in Africa.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more affordable and stable MR vaccines for use in Africa, potentially improving immunization programs and disease prevention efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on stability assessments under controlled conditions, which may not fully represent real-world scenarios. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation was created using non-animal-derived excipients and high-titer MR viral bulks produced in MRC-5 cells. Lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, and a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was used to evaluate stability. The results showed that sucrose/mannitol mixtures were preferred over protein-based bulking agents, and two key stabilizing components—sodium phosphate buffer and urea—were identified. Stability assessments revealed promising profiles for the optimized formulation under real-time and accelerated storage conditions. The findings suggest the feasibility of a lower-cost, multidose MR vaccine for local production in Africa, which could enhance immunization programs. However, the study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on controlled conditions, which may not fully reflect real-world applications. The evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种新型、冻干、减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂,以实现非洲低成本生产,解决资源匮乏地区对经济且稳定的疫苗的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一种冻干MR 疫苗制剂的实验室规模和中试规模冻干循环的开发,研究对象包括在MRC-5细胞中生产的病毒制剂,并在不同条件下评估其稳定性。
elements_zh.methods: 开发了实验室规模和中试规模的冻干循环,实施了高通量RT-qPCR为基础的病毒感染力检测,并采用了有效的赋形剂筛选条件以确定MR病毒的稳定添加剂。
elements_zh.main_results: 首先,避免使用基于蛋白质的填充剂(许多商业冻干MR制剂中使用),而采用蔗糖/甘露醇混合物。其次,筛选了约50种赋形剂,并确定了两种额外的关键稳定成分:磷酸钠缓冲液和尿素。对候选冻干MR制剂的不同变种进行了稳定性评估,以阐明蔗糖–甘露醇比例、冻干块完整性与MR病毒稳定性之间的相互关系。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,一种新型、低成本、冻干、多剂量的MR制剂在非洲本地生产减毒MR 疫苗候选疫苗的潜在应用中是可行的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更经济且稳定的MR 疫苗提供依据,从而改善非洲的免疫接种计划和疾病预防工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要证据,结果基于受控条件下的稳定性评估,可能无法完全反映现实世界的情况。证据强度为中等。

papers.title_zh: 一种新型冻干减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂的开发,旨在实现非洲低成本生产
papers.source_body_en: Background/Objectives: This work describes the development of a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation consists of a stabilizer solution (containing only non-animal-derived excipients) and high-titer MR viral bulks (produced in MRC-5 cells by a modernized process) prepared at a ratio of 95% and 5% (v/v), respectively. Methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses were employed. Based on the down-selected hits, candidate lyophilized MR formulations were designed, prepared, and evaluated by comparative storage stability assessments. Results: First, protein-based bulking agents (used in many commercial lyophilized MR-containing vaccines) were avoided in favor of sucrose/mannitol mixtures. Second, ~50 excipients were screened, and two additional key stabilizing components were identified (both previously reported to stabilize MR viruses): sodium phosphate buffer and urea. Next, stability assessments were performed on different variations of a candidate lyophilized MR formulation to elucidate the inter-relationships between sucrose–mannitol ratios, cake integrity, and MR virus stability. An optimized MR vaccine formulation composition (post-reconstitution) of 5% (w/v) mannitol, 5% (w/v) sucrose, 50 mM urea, 25 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.5), and 5% (v/v) viral bulks was established. When this formulation was lyophilized at lab-scale in a single-dose format, both MR viruses displayed promising stability profiles during storage under real-time and accelerated conditions. A five-dose format was then evaluated in a pilot-scale freeze-dryer by using a 2X formulation filled into larger vials, lyophilized, and then reconstituted to 1X concentration. Conclusions: Results demonstrated the feasibility of a new, lower-cost, lyophilized, multidose MR formulation for potential use with a live-attenuated MR vaccine candidate targeted for local production in Africa.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:本研究描述了一种新型、冻干、减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂的开发,旨在实现非洲低成本生产。该制剂由稳定剂溶液(仅含非动物来源的赋形剂)和高滴度的MR病毒制剂(通过现代化工艺在MRC-5细胞中生产)组成,比例分别为95%和5%(体积比)。方法:开发了实验室规模和中试规模的冻干循环,实施了高通量RT-qPCR为基础的病毒感染力检测,并采用了有效的赋形剂筛选条件以确定MR病毒的稳定添加剂。基于筛选结果,设计、制备并评估了候选冻干MR制剂,通过比较储存稳定性评估。结果:首先,避免使用基于蛋白质的填充剂(许多商业冻干MR制剂中使用),而采用蔗糖/甘露醇混合物。其次,筛选了约50种赋形剂,并确定了两种额外的关键稳定成分(此前均被报道可稳定MR病毒):磷酸钠缓冲液和尿素。随后,对候选冻干MR制剂的不同变种进行了稳定性评估,以阐明蔗糖–甘露醇比例、冻干块完整性与MR病毒稳定性之间的相互关系。最终确定了优化后的MR 疫苗制剂配方(复溶后):5%(重量/体积)甘露醇、5%(重量/体积)蔗糖、50 mM尿素、25 mM磷酸钠缓冲液(pH 6.5)以及5%(体积/体积)病毒制剂。当该制剂以单剂量形式在实验室规模冻干时,两种MR病毒在实时和加速储存条件下均表现出良好的稳定性。随后,在中试规模冻干机中评估了五剂量形式,采用2倍浓度的制剂填充到更大的安瓿中,冻干后复溶至1倍浓度。结论:结果表明,一种新型、低成本、冻干、多剂量的MR制剂在非洲本地生产减毒MR 疫苗候选疫苗的潜在应用中是可行的。研究结果可为开发更经济且稳定的MR 疫苗提供依据,从而改善非洲的免疫接种计划和疾病预防工作。局限性与证据强度:本研究仅基于摘要证据,结果基于受控条件下的稳定性评估,可能无法完全反映现实世界的情况。证据强度为中等。

papers.title: Socioeconomic Determinants of Measles Incidence, Outbreaks, and Vaccination Non-Completion Among Children Under Five in Southeast Asia: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: This systematic review investigates the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and measles incidence, outbreaks, transmission, and routine immunization non-completion among children under five years of age in Southeast Asia. While global literature documents general disparities in childhood vaccination, significant research gaps remain regarding how context-specific parental factors—specifically household income, parental education, maternal literacy, and employment status—interact with structural healthcare access to drive pediatric disease susceptibility. By systematically synthesizing empirical quantitative observational studies (cross-sectional, cohort, case-control, and ecological) published in English between 2016 and 2025, this project aims to isolate the primary socioeconomic determinants influencing measles infection and incomplete vaccination within Southeast Asian countries like Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Ultimately, the expected outcomes will yield empirical, context-specific evidence to help public health policymakers design targeted equity interventions, strengthen routine immunization coverage, and prevent measles outbreaks across vulnerable pediatric populations.
authors: NIK FARESHA SOFEA BINTI FARIQ IDZHAR

papers.abstract_zh: 本系统综述探讨了社会经济地位(SES)与东南亚5岁以下儿童麻疹 发病率、暴发、传播以及常规免疫接种未完成之间的关系。尽管全球文献记录了儿童疫苗接种的一般差异,但关于特定情境下的父母因素——特别是家庭收入、父母教育水平、母亲识字率和就业状况——如何与结构性医疗保健获取相互作用以驱动儿童疾病易感性的研究仍存在重大空白。通过系统地综合2016年至2025年间发表的英文实证定量观察性研究(横断面、队列研究、病例对照和生态研究),本项目旨在识别影响东南亚国家(如马来西亚、印度尼西亚、泰国、菲律宾和越南)中麻疹感染和不完全疫苗接种的主要社会经济决定因素。最终,预期结果将产生实证且情境特定的证据,以帮助公共卫生政策制定者设计有针对性的公平干预措施,加强常规免疫接种覆盖率,并预防麻疹 暴发在易感儿童群体中的传播。

papers.title: Factors Associated with Length of Hospital Stay and Clinical Characteristics of Children Hospitalized with Measles
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the clinical characteristics, complications, and factors associated with the length of hospital stay in children hospitalized with measles. Materials and Methods: This retrospective, observational study included children aged 0-18 years hospitalized with measles between January and December 2023 at a tertiary care center in Istanbul, Türkiye. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, and hospitalization data were analyzed. Results: Sixty-one hospitalized children with measles were included; 32 (52.5%) were younger than 5 years and 29 (47.5%) were older than 5 years. Fifty-nine percent were Turkish citizens, 41% were foreign nationals, and 57.4% were male. Overall, 77% were unvaccinated. Fever and rash were present in all patients. Pneumonia was the most common complication (68.9%), followed by hepatitis (11.5%), gingivostomatitis (11.5%), ocular complications (9.8%), and otitis (4.9%). All hepatitis cases occurred in children older than 5 years. Three patients (5.2%) required pediatric intensive care. In univariable linear regression analyses, pneumonia/bronchopneumonia, C-reactive protein (CRP), and white blood cell count were significantly associated with longer hospital stay. In the primary multivariable linear regression model, only CRP remained independently associated with prolonged hospitalization (B = 0.017, 95% CI = 0.0002-0.0333; P = .047). No measles-related deaths occurred. Conclusion: Measles remains a major public health problem, particularly among unvaccinated children. Inflammatory markers were associated with prolonged hospitalization, suggesting that systemic inflammation may contribute to longer inpatient care. Larger multicenter studies are needed to confirm these findings.

papers.title: Estimating measles vaccine effectiveness from Japanese public surveillance data with quantitative bias analysis: study protocol and statistical analysis plan (version 2.4)
papers.abstract: Japan began national measles case-based surveillance in 2008 and was verified as having eliminated endemic transmission in 2015, yet importation-related clusters continue and global resurgence has renewed attention. In an elimination setting, vaccine effectiveness estimation is limited both by small case numbers and by mismatch between where cases arise and whom the reference survey represents. This study estimates VE by the screening method from published Japanese aggregate data, contrasting one or more doses against none, primarily in children aged 2-4 across three periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), with calendar year adjusted within period by a two-group binomial likelihood and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. Ages 5-19 are reported as important secondary results. The distinguishing feature is that quantitative bias analysis is treated as a co-equal part of the result rather than an appendix: missingness in vaccination history is modelled explicitly through the completed vaccination share, with the share among those of unknown status set both as a MAR-equivalent state and at fixed absolute values; selection mismatch between the reference sample and the case-generating population enters as an independently fixed multiplier K; and residual confounding together with differential case ascertainment enters as a multiplier B for the extension to clinical VE. Case counts by age and vaccination history exist only inside published bar charts and were recovered by two independent extractors from PDF vector coordinates, enumerating all integer candidates within a fixed tolerance and reconciling disagreements against the original sources. Coverage of the interval method was verified on synthetic data before the data-dependent steps, and flagged under-coverage in three conditions led to a registered interpretation rule rather than a change of method. No real-data VE has been computed at the time of registration; the information already viewed is enumerated rather than claimed absent. The protocol states in advance that a sensitivity range crossing zero is part of the intended finding about the limits of conditional inference, and is not evidence that the vaccine is ineffective.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aims to estimate measles vaccine effectiveness (VE) in Japan using public surveillance data, addressing the challenge of accurately assessing VE in an elimination setting where case numbers are small and reference populations may not align with case-generating populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a protocol for estimating VE using Japanese public surveillance data, focusing on measles cases and vaccination history across three time periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), primarily in children aged 2-4 years.
analysis.methods: The study employs a screening method to estimate VE from published Japanese aggregate data, comparing one or more doses of measles vaccine against none, using a two-group binomial likelihood model with calendar year adjustments and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals.
analysis.main_results: The main results include VE estimates for children aged 2-4 years, with secondary results reported for ages 5-19 years.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as highlighting the limitations of conditional inference in VE estimation, emphasizing that a sensitivity range crossing zero does not imply vaccine ineffectiveness but rather reflects methodological constraints.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance strategies and the interpretation of VE in elimination settings, contributing to improved understanding of vaccine performance and potential biases in data collection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations such as missing vaccination data and potential selection mismatch, but the evidence strength is considered moderate due to the use of synthetic data verification and a registered interpretation rule.

analysis.summary_en: This study outlines a protocol for estimating measles vaccine effectiveness (VE) in Japan using public surveillance data. It addresses the challenge of VE estimation in an elimination setting, where small case numbers and mismatch between case-generating populations and reference samples limit accuracy. The methods involve a screening approach using a two-group binomial likelihood model with calendar year adjustments and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. The main results include VE estimates for children aged 2-4 years, with secondary results for ages 5-19 years. The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating the limitations of conditional inference, noting that a sensitivity range crossing zero does not indicate vaccine ineffectiveness. The study's implications for public health include informing surveillance strategies and improving the interpretation of VE in elimination contexts. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study accounts for biases through quantitative bias analysis and synthetic data verification, but it does not yet present real-data VE estimates.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用日本公开的监测数据,估计麻疹 疫苗的效果(VE),解决在消除背景下准确评估VE的挑战,其中病例数量较少且参考人群可能与病例产生人群不一致。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项利用日本公开的监测数据估计VE的方案,重点关注麻疹病例和疫苗接种历史,涵盖三个时间段(2008-2014年、2015-2019年、2020-2025年),主要针对2-4岁儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用筛选方法,从已发表的日本汇总数据中估计VE,将一个或多个剂量的麻疹与未接种的疫苗进行比较,使用带有日历年调整的两组二项式似然模型和95百分比轮廓似然区间。
elements_zh.main_results: 主要结果包括2-4岁儿童的VE估计,5-19岁年龄段的VE被报告为次要结果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调在VE估计中条件推断的局限性,指出敏感性范围跨越零并不意味着疫苗无效,而是反映了方法上的限制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为监测策略提供信息,并有助于理解消除背景下VE的评估,从而提高对疫苗表现和数据收集潜在偏倚的认识。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认了一些局限性,如疫苗接种数据的缺失和潜在的选择偏差,但由于使用了合成数据验证和注册的解释规则,证据强度被认为是中等的。

papers.source_body_en: Japan began national measles case-based surveillance in 2008 and was verified as having eliminated endemic transmission in 2015, yet importation-related clusters continue and global resurgence has renewed attention. In an elimination setting, vaccine effectiveness estimation is limited both by small case numbers and by mismatch between where cases arise and whom the reference survey represents. This study estimates VE by the screening method from published Japanese aggregate data, contrasting one or more doses against none, primarily in children aged 2-4 across three periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), with calendar year adjusted within period by a two-group binomial likelihood and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. Ages 5-19 are reported as important secondary results. The distinguishing feature is that quantitative bias analysis is treated as a co-equal part of the result rather than an appendix: missingness in vaccination history is modelled explicitly through the completed vaccination share, with the share among those of unknown status set both as a MAR-equivalent state and at fixed absolute values; selection mismatch between the reference sample and the case-generating population enters as an independently fixed multiplier K; and residual confounding together with differential case ascertainment enters as a multiplier B for the extension to clinical VE. Case counts by age and vaccination history exist only inside published bar charts and were recovered by two independent extractors from PDF vector coordinates, enumerating all integer candidates within a fixed tolerance and reconciling disagreements against the original sources. Coverage of the interval method was verified on synthetic data before the data-dependent steps, and flagged under-coverage in three conditions led to a registered interpretation rule rather than a change of method. No real-data VE has been computed at the time of registration; the information already viewed is enumerated rather than claimed absent. The protocol states in advance that a sensitivity range crossing zero is part of the intended finding about the limits of conditional inference, and is not evidence that the vaccine is ineffective.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用日本公开的监测数据,估计麻疹 疫苗的效果(VE),解决在消除背景下准确评估VE的挑战,其中病例数量较少且参考人群可能与病例产生人群不一致。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项利用日本公开的监测数据估计VE的方案,重点关注麻疹病例和疫苗接种历史,涵盖三个时间段(2008-2014年、2015-2019年、2020-2025年),主要针对2-4岁儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用筛选方法,从已发表的日本汇总数据中估计VE,将一个或多个剂量的麻疹与未接种的疫苗进行比较,使用带有日历年调整的两组二项式似然模型和95百分比轮廓似然区间。
analysis_zh.main_results: 主要结果包括2-4岁儿童的VE估计,5-19岁年龄段的VE被报告为次要结果。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调在VE估计中条件推断的局限性,指出敏感性范围跨越零并不意味着疫苗无效,而是反映了方法上的限制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为监测策略提供信息,并有助于理解消除背景下VE的评估,从而提高对疫苗表现和数据收集潜在偏倚的认识。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认了一些局限性,如疫苗接种数据的缺失和潜在的选择偏差,但由于使用了合成数据验证和注册的解释规则,证据强度被认为是中等的。

papers.title: Laporan Kasus: Campak (Measles) pada Anak
papers.abstract: Campak (measles) merupakan penyakit infeksi virus akut yang sangat menular dan masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat, terutama pada anak-anak. Penyakit ini dapat menyebabkan berbagai komplikasi akibat penurunan sistem imun sementara. Tujuan laporan kasus ini adalah untuk menggambarkan manifestasi klinis, penegakan diagnosis, serta tatalaksana pada pasien campak. Laporan ini merupakan studi deskriptif dengan desain laporan kasus pada seorang anak laki-laki usia 3 tahun 9 bulan yang datang dengan keluhan demam selama 7 hari disertai batuk, pilek, konjungtivitis, serta ruam makulopapular yang menyebar dari belakang telinga ke seluruh tubuh. Pada pemeriksaan fisik ditemukan bercak Koplik pada mukosa bukal. Pemeriksaan laboratorium menunjukkan leukopenia dengan limfositosis relatif. Manifestasi klinis pasien sesuai dengan gambaran khas campak. Pasien mendapatkan tatalaksana suportif berupa cairan intravena, antipiretik, antiemetik, serta vitamin A dosis tinggi, dan menunjukkan perbaikan klinis selama perawatan. Diagnosis campak dapat ditegakkan secara klinis berdasarkan gejala khas dan tanda patognomonik, serta tatalaksana suportif yang adekuat memberikan hasil yang baik dalam perbaikan kondisi pasien.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Campak (measles) remains a major public-health problem in children, and this case report was needed to document clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management in a single pediatric patient.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a descriptive case-report study of one 3-year-old boy presenting with fever for seven days, cough, rhinorrhea, conjunctivitis, and a maculopapular rash spreading from the retroauricular region to the whole body.
analysis.methods: The report describes clinical observation, physical examination including Koplik spots on buccal mucosa, laboratory findings of leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis, and supportive management with intravenous fluids, antipyretics, antiemetics, and high-dose vitamin A.
analysis.main_results: Physical examination revealed Koplik spots on buccal mucosa; laboratory tests showed leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis; the patient received supportive care and showed clinical improvement during treatment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret Koplik spots as a pathognomonic sign supporting clinical diagnosis of measles, and they conclude that adequate supportive therapy yields favorable clinical outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Clinical diagnosis based on characteristic signs and Koplik spots can suffice for measles confirmation, and supportive care including high-dose vitamin A contributes to favorable recovery.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: This is an abstract-only report from a single pediatric case, so the evidence is limited to one patient and cannot establish prevalence, causality, or generalizability beyond the described case.

analysis.summary_en: Measles remains a major public-health problem in children, and this case report documents clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management in a single 3-year-old boy with Koplik spots, leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis, and favorable response to supportive care including high-dose vitamin A.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将Koplik斑解释为支持麻疹(麻疹)临床诊断(诊断)的特征性体征,并得出结论:适当的综合支持治疗可带来良好的临床结果。

papers.title: Antiviral activity of HSP90 inhibitors against Mumps virus and related paramyxoviruses
papers.abstract: Abstract Mumps virus (MuV), a member of the family Paramyxoviridae , continues to cause recurrent outbreaks worldwide despite widespread vaccination. Currently, however, no antiviral drugs have been approved for MuV or other paramyxoviruses. In this study, we screened approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant MuV expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six compounds that significantly suppressed viral replication without detectable cytotoxicity. These compounds were known inhibitors of heat shock protein 90 (HSP90), a host chaperone involved in the assembly and function of viral polymerase complexes. These HSP90 inhibitors exhibited potent antiviral activity with submicromolar EC50 values and high selectivity indices. Moreover, their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus (MeV), canine distemper virus (CDV), and Sendai virus (SeV). Time-of-addition assays demonstrated that these compounds act at a post-entry stage, primarily during viral RNA synthesis. Consistently, minigenome assays of MuV and Nipah virus (NiV) confirmed robust suppression of viral RNA synthesis without direct inhibition of reporter enzyme activity, indicating target specificity. Collectively, our findings highlight the potential of HSP90 inhibitors as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses and support their further development for the treatment of emerging and re-emerging paramyxovirus infections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify potential antiviral agents against measles virus and related paramyxoviruses, given the ongoing global outbreaks of mumps virus and the lack of approved antiviral drugs for these pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein to identify those that suppress viral replication without cytotoxicity.
analysis.methods: A recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein was used to screen compounds, and time-of-addition assays were conducted to determine the stage of viral replication affected by the inhibitors.
analysis.main_results: Six compounds were identified that significantly suppressed viral replication with no detectable cytotoxicity, and their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses such as measles virus, canine distemper virus, and Sendai virus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HSP90 inhibitors could serve as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses, offering a new approach for treating emerging and re-emerging infections.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for further development of HSP90 inhibitors as potential therapeutic options for paramyxovirus infections, including measles.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro findings, and the evidence strength is moderate as it does not include clinical or in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral activity of HSP90 inhibitors against mumps virus and related paramyxoviruses. Despite widespread vaccination, mumps virus continues to cause outbreaks globally, and no approved antiviral drugs exist for it or other paramyxoviruses. The researchers screened 1,000 compounds using a recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six HSP90 inhibitors that suppressed viral replication without cytotoxicity. These compounds showed efficacy against other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus, canine distemper virus, and Sendai virus. The results suggest that HSP90 inhibitors could be a promising host-directed antiviral strategy for paramyxoviruses. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, and further research is needed to validate these findings in vivo or clinically. The evidence is moderate due to the lack of clinical data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在识别针对腮腺炎病毒及相关副粘病毒的潜在抗病毒药物,鉴于腮腺炎病毒在全球范围内的持续传播以及目前尚无获批用于这些病原体的抗病毒药物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过使用表达绿色荧光蛋白的重组腮腺炎病毒筛选了大约1,000种小分子化合物,以识别那些能够抑制病毒复制且无细胞毒性的化合物。
elements_zh.methods: 使用表达绿色荧光蛋白的重组腮腺炎病毒筛选化合物,并进行时间添加实验以确定抑制剂对病毒复制阶段的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 鉴定了六种能够显著抑制病毒复制且无细胞毒性的化合物,其抗病毒效果还扩展到其他副粘病毒,如麻疹病毒、犬瘟热病毒和仙台病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HSP90抑制剂可能作为针对副粘病毒的抗病毒药物,为治疗新兴和再新兴的副粘病毒感染提供了一种新的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为进一步开发HSP90抑制剂作为治疗副粘病毒感染的潜在治疗药物奠定了基础,包括腮腺炎病毒。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify potential antiviral agents against measles virus and related paramyxoviruses, given the ongoing global outbreaks of mumps virus and the lack of approved antiviral drugs for these pathogens.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein to identify those that suppress viral replication without cytotoxicity.
analysis_en.methods: A recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein was used to screen compounds, and time-of-addition assays were conducted to determine the stage of viral replication affected by the inhibitors.
analysis_en.main_results: Six compounds were identified that significantly suppressed viral replication with no detectable cytotoxicity, and their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses such as measles virus, canine distemper virus, and Sendai virus.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HSP90 inhibitors could serve as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses, offering a new approach for treating emerging and re-emerging infections.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for further development of HSP90 inhibitors as potential therapeutic options for paramyxovirus infections, including measles.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro findings, and the evidence strength is moderate as it does not include clinical or in vivo validation.

papers.title_zh: HSP90抑制剂对腮腺炎病毒及相关副粘病毒的活性
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Mumps virus (MuV), a member of the family Paramyxoviridae , continues to cause recurrent outbreaks worldwide despite widespread vaccination. Currently, however, no antiviral drugs have been approved for MuV or other paramyxoviruses. In this study, we screened approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant MuV expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six compounds that significantly suppressed viral replication without detectable cytotoxicity. These compounds were known inhibitors of heat shock protein 90 (HSP90), a host chaperone involved in the assembly and function of viral polymerase complexes. These HSP90 inhibitors exhibited potent antiviral activity with submicromolar EC50 values and high selectivity indices. Moreover, their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus (MeV), canine distemper virus (CDV), and Sendai virus (SeV). Time-of-addition assays demonstrated that these compounds act at a post-entry stage, primarily during viral RNA synthesis. Consistently, minigenome assays of MuV and Nipah virus (NiV) confirmed robust suppression of viral RNA synthesis without direct inhibition of reporter enzyme activity, indicating target specificity. Collectively, our findings highlight the potential of HSP90 inhibitors as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses and support their further development for the treatment of emerging and re-emerging paramyxovirus infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 腮腺炎病毒(MuV)是副粘病毒科的一种病毒,尽管其在全球范围内广泛传播,但仍持续引起反复感染。然而,目前尚无获批用于MuV或其他副粘病毒的抗病毒药物。在本研究中,我们使用一种表达绿色荧光蛋白的重组MuV筛选了大约1,000种小分子化合物,并鉴定了六种显著抑制病毒复制且无明显细胞毒性的化合物。这些化合物已知是热休克蛋白90(HSP90)的抑制剂,HSP90是一种参与病毒聚合酶复合物组装和功能的伴侣蛋白。这些HSP90抑制剂表现出强效的抗病毒活性,具有亚微摩尔EC50值和高选择性指数。此外,它们的抗病毒效果还扩展到其他副粘病毒,包括麻疹病毒(MeV)、犬瘟热病毒(CDV)和仙台病毒(SeV)。时间添加实验表明,这些化合物在病毒进入后起作用,主要是在病毒RNA合成阶段。一致地,对MuV和尼帕病毒(NiV)的最小基因组实验确认了对病毒RNA合成的强力抑制,而不会直接抑制报告酶活性,表明其作用具有特异性。综上所述,我们的研究结果突显了HSP90抑制剂作为针对副粘病毒的抗病毒药物的潜力,并支持其进一步开发用于治疗新兴和再新兴的副粘病毒感染。

For reprints contact: reprint@ipinnovative.com 1. Introduction Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis (SSPE) remains one of the inevitably devastating long-term complication of wild-type measles virus infection of human.1 It is characterized by progressive cognitive decline, behavioural abnormalities, movement disorders, and eventual autonomic collapse. SSPE primarily afflects the children and young adults in tropical countries. While the classic triad of myoclonic jerks, elevated measles antibody titres in cerebrospinal fluid, and periodic high-voltage slow-wave complexes on electroencephalography (EEG) often anchors the clinical diagnosis, modern neuroimaging (especially magnetic resonance imaging of the brain) plays a crucial role in the staging process, differential diagnosis, and understanding of the pathological evolution of the disease.2 1.1. Conventional neuroimaging The evolving spectrum of structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings of the brain in SSPE dynamically correlates with disease staging, reflecting the anatomical progression of viral neuro-tropism, neuro-inflammation, secondary demyelination, and subsequent cerebral gliosis (Table 1).3 Table 1. Early disease stage: In the early stages, routine T1- and T2-weighted MRI sequences may yield completely normal findings, leading to a delay in its suspicion. Decreased N-acetyl aspartate (NAA)/Creatine (Cr) ratio: Signals significant neuronal and axonal loss/dysfunction. 2. Elevated Choline (Cho)/Creatine (Cr) ratio: Indicates heightened cell membrane turnover and active demyelination. 3. Elevated myo-inositol (mI): Reflects reactive astrogliosis and neuroglia proliferation. 4. papers.title_original: Neuroimaging in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis: unravelling the spectrum of a devastating encephalopathy

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the role of neuroimaging in understanding the progression and staging of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a devastating complication of measles virus infection. The background highlights that SSPE is a long-term consequence of wild-type measles virus infection, marked by progressive cognitive decline, behavioral abnormalities, and eventual autonomic collapse.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a prospective follow-up study focusing on neuroimaging abnormalities in patients diagnosed with subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. It examines the disease's progression across different stages and its impact on brain structures in children and young adults in tropical countries.
analysis.methods: The study employs conventional and advanced neuroimaging techniques, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) mapping, proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), surface-based morphometry (SBM), and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis to assess structural and metabolic changes in SSPE patients.
analysis.main_results: In early stages, MRI findings may be normal or show faint subcortical white matter T2/FLAIR hyperintensities. As the disease progresses, asymmetric parieto-occipital white matter lesions and restricted diffusion are observed. In late stages, confluent white matter loss, basal ganglia/brainstem lesions, and diffuse cerebral/cerebellar atrophy are noted. Advanced imaging techniques reveal decreased N-acetyl aspartate (NAA)/Creatine (Cr) ratio and elevated Choline (Cho)/Creatine (Cr) ratio, indicating neuronal loss and active demyelination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that neuroimaging has evolved into a critical tool for evaluating disease stage, progression, and atypical variants of SSPE, providing insights into the pathological evolution that are not easily discernible through clinical symptoms alone.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the use of neuroimaging in the staging and differential diagnosis of SSPE, aiding in early detection and guiding clinical management in tropical regions where the disease is prevalent.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on neuroimaging findings without detailed statistical analysis or comparison with other diagnostic methods. The evidence is moderate, as it provides descriptive insights into imaging patterns but lacks broader validation or control groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of neuroimaging in understanding the progression of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a severe complication of measles virus infection. It outlines the evolving spectrum of MRI findings across disease stages, from early normal or faint hyperintensities to late-stage atrophy and gliosis. Advanced imaging techniques such as diffusion-weighted imaging and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy reveal metabolic and structural changes, including decreased N-acetyl aspartate/creatine ratio and elevated choline/creatine ratio, indicating neuronal loss and active demyelination. The authors emphasize that neuroimaging has become a nuanced tool for evaluating disease stage and progression, offering critical insights into the pathological evolution of SSPE. The study's implications highlight the importance of neuroimaging in the differential diagnosis of SSPE, particularly in tropical regions. However, the evidence is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and comparison with other diagnostic methods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨神经影像学在了解 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE)(麻疹病毒 感染的破坏性并发症)的进展和分期中的作用。背景强调,SSPE 是野生型 麻疹病毒 感染的长期后果,其特点是进行性认知衰退、行为异常和最终的自主神经崩溃。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项前瞻性随访研究,重点关注诊断为 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 的患者的神经影像异常。它研究了该疾病在不同阶段的进展及其对热带国家儿童和年轻人大脑结构的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用传统和先进的神经影像技术,包括磁共振成像(MRI)、扩散加权成像(DWI)、表观扩散系数(ADC)映射、质子磁共振波谱(MRS)、基于表面的形态测量(SBM)和基于体素的形态测量(VBM)分析来评估SSPE患者的结构和代谢变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 在早期阶段,MRI 结果可能正常或显示微弱的皮质下白质 T2/FLAIR 高信号。随着疾病的进展,可观察到不对称顶枕白质病变和弥散受限。在晚期,会出现融合性白质损失、基底节/脑干病变和弥漫性大脑/小脑萎缩。先进的成像技术显示 N-乙酰天冬氨酸 (NAA)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率降低,胆碱 (Cho)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率升高,表明神经元丢失和活动性脱髓鞘。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,神经影像学已经发展成为评估 SSPE 的疾病阶段、进展和非典型变异的关键工具,为仅通过临床症状不易辨别的病理学 进化 提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为神经影像学在 SSPE 分期和鉴别 诊断 中的应用提供了信息,有助于早期发现并指导该疾病流行的热带地区的临床管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点关注神经影像学结果,没有详细的统计分析或与其他诊断方法的比较。证据是中等的,因为它提供了对成像模式的描述性见解,但缺乏更广泛的验证或对照组。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨神经影像学在了解 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE)(麻疹病毒 感染的破坏性并发症)的进展和分期中的作用。背景强调,SSPE 是野生型 麻疹病毒 感染的长期后果,其特点是进行性认知衰退、行为异常和最终的自主神经崩溃。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项前瞻性随访研究,重点关注诊断为 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 的患者的神经影像异常。它研究了该疾病在不同阶段的进展及其对热带国家儿童和年轻人大脑结构的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用传统和先进的神经影像技术,包括磁共振成像(MRI)、扩散加权成像(DWI)、表观扩散系数(ADC)映射、质子磁共振波谱(MRS)、基于表面的形态测量(SBM)和基于体素的形态测量(VBM)分析来评估SSPE患者的结构和代谢变化。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在早期阶段,MRI 结果可能正常或显示微弱的皮质下白质 T2/FLAIR 高信号。随着疾病的进展,可观察到不对称顶枕白质病变和弥散受限。在晚期,会出现融合性白质损失、基底节/脑干病变和弥漫性大脑/小脑萎缩。先进的成像技术显示 N-乙酰天冬氨酸 (NAA)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率降低,胆碱 (Cho)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率升高,表明神经元丢失和活动性脱髓鞘。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,神经影像学已经发展成为评估 SSPE 的疾病阶段、进展和非典型变异的关键工具,为仅通过临床症状不易辨别的病理学 进化 提供了见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为神经影像学在 SSPE 分期和鉴别 诊断 中的应用提供了信息,有助于早期发现并指导该疾病流行的热带地区的临床管理。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点关注神经影像学结果,没有详细的统计分析或与其他诊断方法的比较。证据是中等的,因为它提供了对成像模式的描述性见解,但缺乏更广泛的验证或对照组。

papers.title: Germicidal ultraviolet to reduce transmission of respiratory infections indoors: a systematic review.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory infections that transmit through air contribute substantially to global morbidity and mortality. Although preclinical data on germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) for air treatment are promising, its real-world effectiveness remains incompletely understood. PURPOSE: Review effectiveness and safety of GUV for preventing respiratory infection transmission. DATA SOURCES: Medline, Embase, Global Health, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, Engineering Village, Epistemonikos, Scopus, and Environmental Science Collection from inception through December 2025. STUDY SELECTION: Studies of GUV with a comparator, measuring human outcomes including respiratory infections, absenteeism, or adverse events. DATA EXTRACTION: At least two investigators extracted data. DATA SYNTHESIS: We identified 57 reports describing 40 studies published between 1940 and 2025: 30 non-randomized controlled trials, 4 randomized controlled trials (RCTs), 4 case series, 1 cohort study, and 1 cross-sectional study. Non-randomized studies indicated GUV reduces infections with high transmissibility through air (measles and chickenpox), although results were mixed for undifferentiated respiratory illnesses and absenteeism. Two RCTs were inconclusive or showed only modest effects. Safety monitoring in 16 studies identified no increased eye or skin irritation from properly installed GUV. All studies had at least one threat to validity; 89% were non-randomized, and 83% lacked statistical power calculations. LIMITATIONS: Heterogeneous study designs, interventions, and outcomes precluded meta-analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Several older clinical studies indicated that GUV reduces infections with high transmissibility through air, but its broader effectiveness against respiratory infection remains uncertain. Inconclusive results may reflect methodological and epidemiological limitations rather than true ineffectiveness. Adequately powered RCTs with robust clinical endpoints are needed. REGISTRATION: https://osf.io/fg6qx.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the effectiveness and safety of germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) for preventing respiratory infection transmission. The study identified 57 reports describing 40 studies published between 1940 and 2025, including non-randomized controlled trials, randomized controlled trials (RCTs), case series, cohort studies, and cross-sectional studies. Non-randomized studies suggested GUV may reduce infections with high transmissibility through air, such as measles and chickenpox, but results were mixed for other respiratory illnesses. Two RCTs were inconclusive or showed only modest effects. Safety monitoring found no increased eye or skin irritation from properly installed GUV. The authors concluded that while older studies indicated GUV's potential for reducing highly transmissible infections, its broader effectiveness remains uncertain. They emphasized the need for adequately powered RCTs with robust clinical endpoints. The study's limitations include heterogeneous designs, lack of statistical power calculations in most studies, and the inability to perform meta-analysis due to variability in interventions and outcomes. The evidence strength is moderate, as the findings are based on a mix of study types with methodological limitations.

papers.title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. papers.abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

papers.title: Hybrid architectures of CNN-ViT and SE-CNN with grad-CAM for monkeypox disease detection
papers.abstract: Abstract In the aftermath of the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, the monkeypox virus (MPV) emerged as a significant global health concern, leading the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare it a public health emergency. Accurate detection of monkeypox (Mpox) is challenging due to its similarity to other pox viruses such as measles and chickenpox. Conventional diagnostic methods often struggle to distinguish between these diseases, necessitating the development of more advanced diagnostic tools. This paper presents a novel approach to detect Mpox using two efficient deep learning (DL) models: the first one is a hybrid architecture of a Convolutional Neural Network—Vision Transformer (CNN–ViT), and the second model is a Squeeze-and-Excitation Convolutional Neural Network (SE-CNN). These models are employed for the classification of medical images into two categories: Monkeypox and Others. The proposed models are applied to a dataset of 1140 images, and utilize fine-tuning for the models’ hyperparameters. Data augmentation techniques are implemented for training images to maximize the models’ performance. Additionally, a gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) visualization technique is applied to explain the decision of the models and aid doctors in clinical decision-making. Experimentally, the accuracy, error matrix, area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, Recall, F1-score, and Precision are used to measure the performance of the proposed models. The CNN–ViT and SE-CNN achieve a testing accuracy of 97.80% and 96.05%, respectively, while the micro-average area under the ROC curve is 97% for CNN–ViT and 99% for SE-CNN. The weighted F1-score, Precision, and Recall for CNN–ViT are all 97.26%, 97.33%, and 97.27%, respectively, while for SE-CNN are 96.04%, 96.13%, and 96.05%, respectively. The proposed models provide a rapid and accurate method to differentiate Mpox from other cases, offering a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in the screening and diagnosis of Mpox.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 大流行后,猴痘病毒 (MPV) 成为全球重大健康问题,导致世界卫生组织 (WHO) 宣布其为突发公共卫生事件。由于猴痘 (Mpox) 与 麻疹 和水痘等其他痘病毒相似,准确检测猴痘 (Mpox) 具有挑战性。传统的诊断方法通常难以区分这些疾病,因此需要开发更先进的诊断工具。本文提出了一种使用两种高效深度学习(DL)模型来检测 Mpox 的新方法:第一个模型是卷积神经网络视觉变换器(CNN-ViT)的混合架构,第二个模型是挤压和激励卷积神经网络(SE-CNN)。这些模型用于将医学图像分为两类:猴痘和其他。所提出的模型应用于 1140 张图像的数据集,并对模型的超参数进行微调。数据增强技术用于训练图像,以最大限度地提高模型的性能。此外,应用梯度加权类激活映射(Grad-CAM)可视化技术来解释模型的决策并帮助医生进行临床决策。实验上,使用准确度、误差矩阵、受试者工作特征(ROC)曲线下面积、召回率、F1 分数和精度来衡量所提出模型的性能。CNN-ViT和SE-CNN的测试精度分别为97.80%和96.05%,而ROC曲线下的微平均面积CNN-ViT为97%,SE-CNN为99%。CNN-ViT 的加权 F1 分数、精度和召回率分别为 97.26%、97.33% 和 97.27%,而 SE-CNN 分别为 96.04%、96.13% 和 96.05%。所提出的模型提供了一种快速、准确的方法来区分 Mpox 与其他病例,为医疗保健专业人员进行 Mpox 筛查和 诊断 提供了宝贵的工具。

papers.title: From sparse data to smart decisions: region-specific policy evaluation via simulation
papers.abstract: Effective infectious disease response requires region-specific guidance, because the contact structures that drive local transmission and shape intervention effects vary from community to community. Agent-based models (ABMs) represent these structures and the individual heterogeneity underlying them, which makes them well suited to local intervention analysis, but they are computationally expensive and difficult to fit directly to data. We present a framework that avoids direct ABM fitting by using a surrogate ordinary differential equation model as an intermediary between routine surveillance data and a mechanistically rich ABM. The surrogate is fit to observed case and hospitalization data using weighted least squares, with profile likelihood used to define a data-consistent ABM parameter region. Intervention effects are evaluated across this region, while stochastic ABM variability is quantified separately through repeated simulations. We apply the framework to COVID-19 in nine demographically distinct Michigan counties as an illustrative case study. For each county, we recover ABM parameter regions consistent with local case and hospitalization data, verify that the calibrated model reproduces observed trajectories, and evaluate four non-pharmaceutical interventions across the ABM parameter regions. The ranking and robustness of interventions differ substantially across counties, and simple demographic predictors do not reliably predict which will succeed. Although we use intervention implementation assumptions drawn from COVID-19 literature, the framework is general and can take user-specified assumptions to evaluate the conclusions they imply. By coupling mechanistic ABMs with explicit uncertainty propagation, this approach provides a generic route to local, uncertainty-aware intervention analysis for COVID-19, influenza, measles, and other pathogens.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a framework for evaluating region-specific interventions against infectious diseases by using a surrogate ordinary differential equation model as an intermediary between surveillance data and mechanistically rich agent-based models (ABMs). The framework is applied to COVID-19 in nine Michigan counties, demonstrating that intervention effectiveness varies significantly across regions and cannot be reliably predicted by simple demographic factors. The approach couples ABMs with explicit uncertainty propagation, offering a generalizable method for local, uncertainty-aware intervention analysis for pathogens like measles, influenza, and others. The study highlights the computational challenges of directly fitting ABMs to data and introduces a method that avoids these limitations. The results suggest that the framework can be adapted to evaluate different intervention assumptions, making it a flexible tool for public health decision-making. However, the study acknowledges that the intervention implementation assumptions are drawn from existing literature and may not account for all local factors.

papers.abstract_zh: 有效的传染病应对措施需要针对特定​​区域的指导,因为推动当地 传播 和塑造干预效果的接触结构因社区而异。基于代理的模型(ABM)代表了这些结构以及它们背后的个体异质性,这使得它们非常适合局部干预分析,但它们的计算成本很高并且难以直接拟合数据。我们提出了一个框架,通过使用代理常微分方程模型作为常规 监测 数据和机械丰富的 ABM 之间的中介,避免直接 ABM 拟合。使用加权最小二乘法将替代项拟合到观察到的病例和住院数据,并使用轮廓似然来定义数据一致的 ABM 参数区域。评估该区域的干预效果,同时通过重复模拟单独量化随机 ABM 变异性。我们将该框架应用于密歇根州九个人口结构不同的县的 COVID-19,作为说明性案例研究。对于每个县,我们恢复与当地病例和住院数据一致的 ABM 参数区域,验证校准模型是否再现了观察到的轨迹,并评估 ABM 参数区域的四种非药物干预措施。各县干预措施的排名和稳健性差异很大,简单的人口预测因素无法可靠地预测哪些干预措施会成功。尽管我们使用从 COVID-19 文献中得出的干预实施假设,但该框架是通用的,可以采用用户指定的假设来评估它们暗示的结论。通过将机械 ABM 与明确的不确定性传播相结合,该方法为针对 COVID-19、流感、麻疹 和其他病原体进行局部、不确定性感知干预分析提供了通用途径。

papers.full_text: BackgroundViral exanthems (VEs), including vaccine-preventable infections such as measles and rubella and non-vaccine-preventable infections such as roseola, remain clinically relevant. Declining vaccination rates and recent outbreaks have increased the importance of timely diagnosis and mandatory reporting. In addition, the relative rarity of vaccine-preventable diseases in modern clinical practice may reduce physician familiarity with these infections.MethodsThis IRB-exempt cross-sectional study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of Florida physicians regarding VE diagnosis and reporting requirements using a 19-question Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap; Vanderbilt University, Nashville, USA) survey. Participants included physicians and residents in family medicine, pediatrics, internal medicine, and infectious disease specialties. Statistical analyses included analysis of variance (ANOVA), multivariate ANOVA (MANOVA), Tukey post hoc testing, and linear regression.ResultsA total of 162 physicians completed the survey, with 146 complete responses included in inferential analyses. Pediatricians demonstrated the highest overall knowledge scores (82.66%), followed by internal medicine (76.39%) and family medicine physicians (73.26%). Overall knowledge differences among specialties were significant (F(2,143) = 3.31, p = 0.039), with pediatricians scoring significantly higher than family medicine physicians. No significant specialty differences were identified when vignette-based diagnostic or mandatory reporting questions were analyzed independently. Most physicians, 148 (91.36%), expressed interest in additional training on VE diagnosis and management. Greater physician confidence was significantly associated with higher diagnostic knowledge (β = 10.73, p < 0.001) and reporting knowledge (β = 9.68, p < 0.001). Roseola was the most commonly diagnosed VE in clinical practice, followed by measles and rubella.ConclusionFlorida physicians demonstrated moderate-to-high knowledge of VE diagnosis and reporting requirements; however, notable gaps remained, particularly in differentiating rubella from similar exanthems. Interpretation is limited by the non-random respondent sample, uneven speciality representation, and potential nonresponse bias. Pediatricians outperformed family medicine physicians, although deficiencies were observed across specialties. These findings identify areas in which additional physician education may be beneficial, particularly regarding the clinical differentiation of viral exanthems and mandatory reporting requirements. As vaccination rates decline and outbreaks increase, improving early recognition and reporting of VE remains important for outbreak prevention and public health preparedness. Materials and methodsOverall study designThis IRB-exempt cross-sectional study utilized an online 19-question survey that consisted of six demographic/professional questions, six knowledge questions, five attitude questions, and two practice questions. The methodology for this study was closely modeled after that of a preliminary study [19], with modifications to address the specific aims of the present investigation. The modified survey focused on viral exanthem diagnosis, mandatory reporting requirements, physician confidence, and self-reported clinical practices. The modified instrument did not undergo formal content validation or reliability testing. See Appendices for the list of questions utilized. The inclusion criteria for this study were actively licensed physicians (DO or MD) or residents with a medical training license. Specialties of focus included primary care, family medicine/practice, pediatrics, internal medicine, and infectious disease. Overall, the questions tested participants' knowledge of viral exanthem diagnosis, treatment, and risk factors. No intervention or treatment was used in this study.Participants and specialtiesPrior research has established deficiencies in knowledge of VE amongst physicians. However, no studies specifically measured responses from physicians practicing in the state of Florida, and no studies have examined mandatory reporting requirements in the United States. Potential participants were first identified utilizing the Florida Department of Health public practitioner profile database of healthcare professionals, filtered by license in “active” status as of November 2024, county, and specialty. A broad county-based recruitment strategy was used to identify eligible physicians. The specialties of choice were family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, and infectious disease. Emails of 1085 family medicine, 1265 pediatric, and 491 infectious disease doctors were collected. Internal medicine physicians were not independently targeted during the initial email recruitment process. Responders classified as internal medicine were identified based on reported specialty or subspecialty information on the survey. Survey responses were collected from January 2025 to July 2025. Participants were recruited from the Florida Department of Health practitioner database using predefined specialty and county criteria. This was not a probability-based random sample of all eligible Florida physicians. Counties were broadly grouped into three geographic regions: North, Central, or South Florida. full_text_sections.abstract: BackgroundViral exanthems (VEs), including vaccine-preventable infections such as measles and rubella and non-vaccine-preventable infections such as roseola, remain clinically relevant. Declining vaccination rates and recent outbreaks have increased the importance of timely diagnosis and mandatory reporting. In addition, the relative rarity of vaccine-preventable diseases in modern clinical practice may reduce physician familiarity with these infections.MethodsThis IRB-exempt cross-sectional study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of Florida physicians regarding VE diagnosis and reporting requirements using a 19-question Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap; Vanderbilt University, Nashville, USA) survey. Participants included physicians and residents in family medicine, pediatrics, internal medicine, and infectious disease specialties. Statistical analyses included analysis of variance (ANOVA), multivariate ANOVA (MANOVA), Tukey post hoc testing, and linear regression.ResultsA total of 162 physicians completed the survey, with 146 complete responses included in inferential analyses. Pediatricians demonstrated the highest overall knowledge scores (82.66%), followed by internal medicine (76.39%) and family medicine physicians (73.26%). Overall knowledge differences among specialties were significant (F(2,143) = 3.31, p = 0.039), with pediatricians scoring significantly higher than family medicine physicians. No significant specialty differences were identified when vignette-based diagnostic or mandatory reporting questions were analyzed independently. Most physicians, 148 (91.36%), expressed interest in additional training on VE diagnosis and management. Greater physician confidence was significantly associated with higher diagnostic knowledge (β = 10.73, p < 0.001) and reporting knowledge (β = 9.68, p < 0.001). Roseola was the most commonly diagnosed VE in clinical practice, followed by measles and rubella.ConclusionFlorida physicians demonstrated moderate-to-high knowledge of VE diagnosis and reporting requirements; however, notable gaps remained, particularly in differentiating rubella from similar exanthems. Interpretation is limited by the non-random respondent sample, uneven speciality representation, and potential nonresponse bias. Pediatricians outperformed family medicine physicians, although deficiencies were observed across specialties. These findings identify areas in which additional physician education may be beneficial, particularly regarding the clinical differentiation of viral exanthems and mandatory reporting requirements. As vaccination rates decline and outbreaks increase, improving early recognition and reporting of VE remains important for outbreak prevention and public health preparedness.

full_text_sections.discussion: DiscussionIn this survey, physicians practicing in Florida were assessed for their knowledge, attitudes, and opinions related to the diagnostic workup of VE and clinical practices pertaining to VE (measles, rubella, roseola). Physician responses across these domains revealed knowledge gaps and limited confidence in the diagnosis and mandatory reporting of VE. Our study confirms that respondents reported diagnosing measles, rubella, and roseola during their careers, highlighting the continued and emerging public health relevance of viral exanthems in the southeastern United States.The knowledge-based question on which physicians demonstrated the lowest performance involved diagnosing rubella from a clinical vignette, whereas the highest-scoring question addressed mandatory reporting guidelines of rubella. These findings suggest that physicians may be familiar with reporting once viral exanthem diagnoses are made, but clinical differentiation of similar rash presentations remains a challenge. Among specialties, pediatricians achieved the highest mean score, followed by internal medicine (IM) and family medicine (FM). This distribution is consistent with the epidemiology of VE, which is commonly present in the pediatric population [20]. Mean knowledge scores were statistically comparable among specialties, with the exception of pediatricians, who had a statistically significantly higher mean score than FM physicians. This finding was somewhat unexpected, as ambulatory pediatricians and FM physicians are typically the first to encounter VE cases, while involvement of an IM or infectious disease (ID) physician more often requires a referral or for the patient to first be seen by an emergency medicine physician.Although specialty-based differences in vignette-based and mandatory reporting knowledge were not statistically significant when examined independently, there was an overall trend toward lower performance among non-pediatric specialties. This suggests that experience and clinical exposure may influence applied knowledge. This could be attributed to multiple reasons. One reason is that pediatricians and infectious disease physicians have more exposure to VE and thus must be constantly up-to-date on regulations and mandatory reporting. Importantly, multivariate analyses did not demonstrate a combined specialty effect on diagnostic and reporting knowledge, indicating that gaps are present across disciplines rather than limited to a single specialty.Findings on physician attitudes further contextualize these findings. The majority of respondents reported feeling “somewhat confident” in diagnosing and reporting VE. Self-reported confidence was positively associated with knowledge scores, suggesting some concordance between perceived and measured knowledge. These findings, in conjunction with the near-unanimous physician desire for increased training in addressing and managing VE in Florida, underscore perceived knowledge deficits and discrepancies. These findings support evaluating targeted educational interventions in future studies. Additionally, incorporating refresher modules or didactic content within continuing medical education may meaningfully improve outcomes and mandatory reporting practices.The trend of declining vaccination rates has been an ongoing topic of concern for years. Vaccination coverage has been experiencing a trending decline in Florida among kindergartners since the 2018-2019 school year, with coverage for school-mandated vaccines dropping below 90% in the 2024-2025 school year, undermining herd immunity [21]. Our study shows that, correspondingly, some vaccine-preventable diseases have seen an increase in the United States in recent years. The most memorable instance has been the recent surge of measles cases across the country, predominantly in areas with lower vaccination rates [16]. Also notable has been the increase in pertussis in 2024 and 2025, with reported cases in 2024 being six times higher than pre-pandemic 2019 rates [22]. Other vaccine-preventable diseases, including mumps, toxigenic C. diphtheria, rubella, invasive pneumococcal disease, and Haemophilus influenzae type B-associated epiglottitis, have not reported significantly increased national rates, which may be attributed to high overall vaccination rates [23, 24, 25, 26, 27]. These trends are a warning to practicing health professionals across the country and possibly threaten major setbacks for public health. Due to vaccine mandates, newer generations of Florida physicians who began practicing in this century have encountered the lowest number of cases of vaccine-preventable disease in United States history, leading to concerns regarding lack of experience in recognition and management of these diseases [28, 29].LimitationsThis study has potential limitations that should be considered. These limitations are primarily methodological. First, the process of participant recruitment relied on email addresses provided publicly by the Florida Department of Health practitioner database, with a direct focus on FM, pediatrics, and infectious disease physicians. IM physicians were not initially targeted during the email collection process. Instead, they were identified through subspecialty categorization of existing survey responses. This represents a sampling limitation that may have contributed to uneven specialty representation and response rates.Secondly, the study focused mainly on FM, pediatrics, and IM, which may not be fully representative of the knowledge and practices of VE across all specialties, such as emergency medicine, dermatology, and obstetrics, where VE may also be encountered. Therefore, the study’s findings are more reflective of primary-care-based settings. Responses were also obtained from multiple metropolitan regions across Florida. This may result in the overall response rate being limited, and some counties were minimally represented. This geographic imbalance may limit the generalizability of findings to all practice settings, particularly in rural or underserved areas. The low overall response rate relative to the contacted pool of physicians raises the possibility of nonresponse bias, potentially overrepresenting higher knowledge levels and more favorable attitudes. Since the survey participation was voluntary through publicly available physician contact information, this may have introduced selection and nonresponse bias.
